title: How PrimeXBT’s TradingView Integration Helps Traders Navigate Always-on Crypto Markets
summary: Bitcoin can move sharply overnight, during a weekend or while a trader is away from their screen. By the time they check the price again, a level they were watching may already have been broken. That is why alerts, technical indicators and tools for testing strategies have become important for monitoring price movements, analysing volatility and making informed trading decisions. As crypto markets have matured, traders have gained access to more sophisticated technology to navigate this 24/7 environment. PrimeXBT, a global multi-asset broker and crypto asset service provider, has now integrated with TradingView, giving its clients access to these tools alongside the ability to place Crypto Futures and CFD trades directly from the TradingView platform, while benefiting from top-tier trading conditions and the flexibility to use crypto as trading capital. Why crypto traders need more than basic charts Early crypto exchanges generally offered basic charts and order books, which meant traders looking for more detailed analysis often had to use separate charting tools. Today, they can examine multiple timeframes, add technical indicators and set price alerts, while historical testing tools help them assess strategies against earlier market conditions. Traders often follow several coins at once, and price alerts notify them when a market reaches a chosen level. Historical charts also show how a strategy performed during previous rallies and sell-offs. With hundreds of coins and a growing range of derivatives, screeners let traders scan by price move, volume and technical conditions. TradingView brings these capabilities together in a single analytical environment. Used by more than 100 million traders and investors worldwide, the platform covers cryptocurrencies alongside shares, forex, commodities and indices, allowing traders to analyse different markets using the same tools. It offers 400+ built-in indicators and strategies, more than 100,000 public community indicators, and Pine Script for building custom indicators, strategies and alerts. Bar Replay rewinds the market to test an idea against past conditions, and its screeners cover crypto coins as well as pairs on centralised and decentralised exchanges. Together, these tools help crypto traders monitor multiple markets, respond to price movements and evaluate strategies in an environment where volatility can emerge at any time. Trading crypto with PrimeXBT on TradingView As a verified TradingView broker, PrimeXBT allows clients to connect an existing account or create one through the Trade panel and place orders directly from the TradingView platform. This connects advanced market analysis with trade execution in a single environment. For example, a trader monitoring Bitcoin on a four-hour chart might identify a trading range and set alerts at both edges. When an alert is triggered, they can review the price movement, compare it with developments in gold and the US 500, and decide whether the conditions support a potential trade. If they choose to act, they can place the order through their connected PrimeXBT account without leaving TradingView. PrimeXBT’s authorisation screen lists what TradingView can do on the account: open and manage orders, close active positions and check the balance, but it has no permission to withdraw funds. PrimeXBT offers more than 350 instruments across Crypto Futures, Crypto CFDs and CFDs on forex, commodities, indices and shares, including more than 170 Crypto Futures markets. This allows crypto traders to explore opportunities across digital assets and traditional financial markets through a single account. Crypto Futures on PXTrader 2.0 trade against a real order book with visible liquidity, while maker fees are 0.01% and taker fees start at 0.045%, falling as low as 0.015% through broker’s volume-based VIP tier program. CFD trading is commission-free with tight spreads. New clients also receive VIP 4 tier for their first 14 days, including a 33% discount on Crypto Futures taker fees and 25% on CFD spreads. Clients can hold accounts in USD, USDT, USDC, BTC or ETH and fund them with crypto or fiat currency. This allows crypto traders to use digital assets as trading capital while accessing a broader range of financial markets. For example, clients holding Bitcoin can open an account in BTC and use that balance as margin collateral for CFD positions in markets such as gold or shares, without converting it to USD first. The Future of Crypto Trading: More Advanced and Connected As crypto markets continue to mature, the ability to navigate round-the-clock volatility will remain a defining part of the trading experience. Technology is making it easier for traders to stay informed, assess opportunities and swiftly respond to market developments. PrimeXBT’s integration with TradingView brings advanced analysis, trade execution together and top-tier trading conditions, helping shape a more connected and efficient trading experience for crypto traders navigating fast-moving markets. Trade with PrimeXBT on TradingView About PrimeXBT PrimeXBT is a global multi-asset broker and crypto asset service provider trusted by traders in more than 150 countries. The platform bridges traditional and digital markets within one integrated environment, redefining versatility and innovation in online trading. Clients can access Forex, CFDs on indices, commodities, shares, crypto, and Crypto Futures, as well as buy, store and exchange cryptocurrencies. This unified experience extends across both the native PXTrader 2.0 platform, MetaTrader 5 and TradingView, supported by advanced risk-management tools and a wide range of funding options in crypto, fiat and local payment methods. Since 2018, PrimeXBT has focused on empowering traders through broad multi-asset access, fair and transparent conditions, professional-grade technology and dedicated human support. By combining expertise, trust and a client-first approach, PrimeXBT sets a benchmark of excellence in the financial industry and provides traders with the tools they need to trade, grow and succeed with confidence.
